label: vote-mode evidence, votes as of the end of the pull; count-based replay
limits: Whether a row is decided, and its majority, uses votes as of the pull's end: an early checkpoint here sees votes that did not exist yet. Contested labels are decided later, so this understates early false graduation.
Every previous-era vote was collected in vote mode; this says nothing about how evidence accrues in shadow mode.
No dates and no waiting times: the pull has no vote timestamps.
The previous era mixes model revisions (releases before API 1.0.2 loaded the hub's main branch).
